# Test fixtures: Cloudera dbt-spark-cde-example

These four CSV files (cases, vaccines, country codes, populations) are copied unmodified from
https://github.com/cloudera/dbt-spark-cde-example (`dbt_spark_cde_demo/seeds`),
licensed under the Apache License 2.0. The COVID case data is synthetic (generated by the
example's `util/data_gen/generate_data.py`), and the reference tables are public country data.
